sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The letter (ache) /aʃ/ has no sound of its own. It is completely silent in the word (habiter) /a.bi.te/, which means to live. This letter never makes any sound in French words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: You make no movement with your mouth. Your tongue and lips stay ready for the next letter. No air puffs out from your throat. Hold a hand before your lips to feel no puff of breath.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter is always silent. It makes no sound in (homme) /ɔm/. It also makes no sound in (héros) /e.ʁo/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not breathe out like the first sound in hat. Keep your throat quiet. Go straight to the next vowel with no breath.
